text:
for any losing bets and bid types with big enough samples, make the engine never auto bet or auto bid these types of bets and bids. for the vigilant android app, make any of these types of bets in any scanner have a red x or some type of warning sign big enough that I can't ignore it so I am warned to stay away from this bet.

then consider: if I'm losing so much on these types of bets, for example player prop overs, shouldn't I just bet and bid the other side (the under in this example)? if this is logical, tune the GitHub engine to automatically do so
